settings.title: Simple Membership That Gives You More Ways to Play
Everything You Need to Elevate Your Padel Experience

settings.editor: Our membership is designed to support every type of player, whether you’re sharpening your skills, training competitively, or just enjoying weekly matches with friends. Each benefit is crafted to give you more flexibility, priority access, and value every time you play.
Enjoy exclusive playing hours and easy booking, ensuring you always find your perfect match time.
Train with our certified coaches at preferred member-only rates for private, group, and junior programs.
Compete more and pay less with special pricing for tournaments, socials, and club events.
Bring friends or family along and share the excitement of padel with flexible guest access.
Secure your spot first for clinics, camps, special events, and limited-seat training programs.
Get access to exclusive meetups, social events, and seasonal gatherings that make every visit more meaningful.
Enjoy unlimited court bookings, discounted coaching sessions, access to exclusive tournaments, and priority entry to social events.
No joining fee. Cancel anytime with 30 days’ notice.

settings.description_text: Play anytime with no booking limits or extra fees.
Save up to 20% on private lessons and clinics.
Compete in members-only leagues and friendly matches.
Get first access to social nights, exhibitions, and workshops.

settings.title: A Membership Built to Make Every Match Better

settings.editor: Players join Pickyard not just for the courts, but for the atmosphere, energy, and top-tier conditions that help them grow. Our commitment to coaching quality, community connection, and facility excellence makes the membership feel worthwhile from day one.

sg_testimonials_list.sg_testimonials_list_review: “Pickyard Padel Club is the ultimate padel destination! The atmosphere is fantastic, and it’s the perfect place to meet fellow padel enthusiasts.”

items.item_title: Is there a contract or commitment?
Can I pause my membership if I am unavailable?
Are events included in the membership?

settings.editor: Absolutely. Our coaches work with all skill levels, and many members start as first-time players.
Membership is flexible, and you can choose the billing cycle that works best for you.
Yes, short-term holds can be arranged under certain conditions.
Members get discounted entry for tournaments, social nights, and special events.
Whether you’re looking to improve your game, meet new friends, or simply find your place in the world of padel, Pickyard welcomes you.
